say:8:1210406007:1.text: Hey! What are you talking about? I'm trying to help them escape...

choice_prompt:9:1210406007.text: Hey! What are you talking about? I'm trying to help them escape...
choice_prompt:9:1210406007.source_cn: ——喂喂喂，别直接卖我！我准备带他们借条船逃走呢！

say:10:1210406008:1.text: Okay, I'll be honest. I am somewhat connected to the Carmine Whispers. Hugin is a talented craftsman who can make all sorts of interesting things. I just introduced him to the Whispers.
say:10:1210406008:1.source_cn: 好吧，我摊牌，其实……我和血薇帮有点交情。呼金是个不错...

say:11:1210406009:1.text: Hugin's making a special cannon to deal with the Dead Tide Fleet. He's in need of a mage, and it just so happens that you're in need of a ship. I was thinking if you could do him a favor, he could do you a favor.
say:11:1210406009:1.source_cn: 呼金研究对付死潮舰队的火炮，缺个魔法师，正好你们缺船。...
say:11:1210406009:1.male: Hugin's making a special cannon to deal with the Dead Tide Fleet. He's in need of a mage, and it just so happens that you're in need of a ship. I was thinking if you could do him a favor, he could do you a favor.

say:13:1210406010:1.text: But he opened fire as soon as he saw us!
say:13:1210406010:1.source_cn: 但这家伙一看见我们就开炮！

say:14:1210406011:1.text: Yes, well, that couldn't be helped. The Water Wights have been restless lately, and we've been on high alert for a while.
say:14:1210406011:1.source_cn: 没办法，最近水鬼帮的不老实，我们也绷着一根弦，看到只松...

say:15:1210406012:1.text: Look, let's be friends. If you want a ship, I can help. I just need your help with enchantments.
say:15:1210406012:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，不打不相识，你要船，好说好说！只要你们帮我附魔！

say:18:1210406013:1.text: You didn't even apologize to Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and you're already asking for something? How rude!
say:18:1210406013:1.male: You didn't even apologize to Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and you're already asking for something? How rude!
say:18:1210406013:1.female: You didn't even apologize to Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and you're already asking for something? How rude!

say:19:1210406014:1.text: Apologize to the magister? Well, I'm sorry then! You can shoot me if that'll make you feel better. I'm serious. Whistler, Hardhead, Fireside, and Shorty... They all agree with me.
say:19:1210406014:1.source_cn: 道歉？我有诚意！你可以朝我开一炮消气。我是说真的，尖哨...
say:19:1210406014:1.male: Apologize to the magister? Well, I'm sorry then! You can shoot me if that'll make you feel better. I'm serious. Whistler, Hardhead, Fireside, and Shorty... They all agree with me.
say:19:1210406014:1.female: Apologize to the magister? Well, I'm sorry then! You can shoot me if that'll make you feel better. I'm serious. Whistler, Hardhead, Fireside, and Shorty... They all agree with me.

say:20:1210406015:1.text: Who are Whistler, Hardhead, Fireside, and Shorty?

say:21:1210406016:1.text: They are my best friends, my assistants, and my inspiration! Look, they're saying hello to you!
say:21:1210406016:1.source_cn: 他们是我的挚友，最好的助手，给力的观众，还有最棒的灵感...

say:22:1210406017:1.text: Umm... you mean that your prosthetic, hammer, furnace, and forge... have names...
say:22:1210406017:1.source_cn: 呃……你是说，你的金属假肢，大铁锤，烧火炉，锻造台叫尖...

say:23:1210406018:1.text: That's right! And you remembered all of them! Look, they're so happy.
say:23:1210406018:1.source_cn: 火墙，矮地。没错！太棒了，你居然记住他们的名字了，瞧，...

say:24:1210406019:1.text: Hugin seems to be able to see the souls of things... if that's even possible.
say:24:1210406019:1.source_cn: 呼金……他仿佛能看到这些东西的灵魂——如果它们有的话。

say:27:1210406020:1.text: You'll get used to it. When I first met Hugin, he surprised me too. I learned later that he's just a crazy inventor. He gets the most riled up when he's talking about his creations.
say:27:1210406020:1.source_cn: 习惯就好，我刚认识呼金的时候，也被他吓了一跳。后来才知...

say:28:1210406021:1.text: Please help enchant my Flintblaster! With your magic, we'll be invincible!
say:28:1210406021:1.source_cn: 请帮小金箭附魔吧！有你的魔法，加上我的技术，我们肯定攻...

say:29:1210406022:1.text: Wait... Don't tell me Flintblaster is the name of your cannon.

say:30:1210406023:1.text: Yes, that's right! I shot you with my Flintblaster. I improved its trajectory by three inches by adjusting the core and adding a wispstone to the saltpeter.
say:30:1210406023:1.source_cn: 喏，刚才那一炮，就是小金箭发射的，我把他的弹道改良了三...

say:31:1210406024:1.text: Hugin, we're not interested in hearing how you improved your cannon. The magister hasn't agreed to help you yet. Keep talking like that and he'll leave.
